Be admitted to one of the undergraduate programs** | This applies to both modalities. | This applies to both modalities. | | **2\. Have the tuition payment receipt for the semester to be financed.** | This applies to both modalities. | This applies to both modalities. | | **3\. Have a person responsible for payment and a guarantor for the loan.** | -  If the student is a minor, they must have a responsible party for payment and a guarantor. The responsible party for payment and the guarantor must be of legal age.
- If the student has income, they may be responsible for payment.
- In all cases, a guarantor is required and must be under 65 years of age.
- If the guarantor is a pensioner, they must have income in addition to their pension. | - The person responsible for payment and guarantor must be of legal age.
- If the student has income, they may be responsible for payment.
- In all cases, a guarantor is required and must be under 65 years of age.
- If the guarantor is a pensioner, they must have income in addition to their pension. | | **4\. Complete the loan application form and provide the references published on the financing website.** | You must have a personal and family reference from the person responsible for payment and the guarantor. | You must have a personal and family reference from the person responsible for payment and the guarantor. | ## Required documentation for application - [1\. Complete the digital form](https://www.eafit.edu.co/proceso-de-aplicacion-financiacion-estudiantes-nuevos-posgrados#230548828-1412504341) - [2\. Have the following information ready:](https://www.eafit.edu.co/proceso-de-aplicacion-financiacion-estudiantes-nuevos-posgrados#230548828-1110430411) - [3\. Supporting documents for income of the person responsible for payment and the guarantor(s)](https://www.eafit.edu.co/proceso-de-aplicacion-financiacion-estudiantes-nuevos-posgrados#230548828-3189179928) ###### It applies to both modalities, short and long term. [1\. Complete the digital form](https://www.eafit.edu.co/proceso-de-aplicacion-financiacion-estudiantes-nuevos-posgrados#230548828-1412504341) El primer paso, para comenzar a diligenciar del formulario ( [formulario digital](https://financiacion.eafit.edu.co/home)), es el registro de la persona que se hará responsable de​l pago de la financiación. Si eres menor de edad debes tener en cuenta que quien debe registrarse es el responsable del pago ante la Universidad. ​​ [2\. Have the following information ready:](https://www.eafit.edu.co/proceso-de-aplicacion-financiacion-estudiantes-nuevos-posgrados#230548828-1110430411) Tener a la mano los datos del documento de identidad del estudiante, el responsable de pago y del avalista. [3\. Supporting documents for income of the person responsible for payment and the guarantor(s)](https://www.eafit.edu.co/proceso-de-aplicacion-financiacion-estudiantes-nuevos-posgrados#230548828-3189179928) **De acuerdo con la actividad de cada uno:** - ​ **Empleado:** Certificado Laboral con fecha de expedición inferior a 30 días, indicando ingresos, tipo de contrato. En caso de ser a termino fijo, indicar la fecha de terminación del contrato. - **Independiente:** Certificado del ingreso mensual, emitido por un Contador público y copia de la tarjeta profesional del contador. Si declara renta complementar con la última declaración presentada. - **Prestación de Servicios:** Certificado de la empresa a la cual presta los servicios con fecha de expedición inferior a 30 días, indicando ingresos , tipo de contrato, en caso de ser a término fijo, indicar la fecha de terminación. ​ ​ ## Apply for your loan [Read more](https://financiacion.eafit.edu.co/home) ## Instructive [Application tutorial](https://www.eafit.edu.co/instructivo-eafit-tu-alcance) ## Simulate your loan [Calculate your loan here](https://www.eafit.edu.co/simulador-de-eafit-tu-alcance) ## Regulation ## For the short term [See regulations](https://universidadeafit.widen.net/s/lxpzbmr7jl/reglamento-credito-eafit-corto-plazo) ## For the long term [See
